name: Deployd
author: c-wenlong
description: The tailnet-only answer to webhooks: a systemd user timer that polls every services/*/app.json deploy block, ff-pulls this checkout, resolves each watched git ref, and runs that service's deploy command when the remote moved. State lives under ~/services/deployd/state — one <key>.sha/.fail/.log triplet per service — which is what the launcher's /api/deployd surface reads. Stop pauses the timer (no more polls); start resumes it.
